title: HSK 1.4 · 时间, 最后, 多少, 明白, 房子
focus: 用 · 多 · 两 · 等 · 吗 · 天 · 太 · 最 · 再 · 呢 · 次 · 小 · 知道 · 时候 · 走 · 后 · 时间 · 今天 · 孩子 · 最后 · 女 · 小时 · 明天 · 多少 · 少 · 间 · 昨天 · 子 · 儿子 · 明白 · 今年 · 女儿 · 白 · 去年 · 不用 · 房子 · 回去 · 房间 · 有时
body:
Time and quantity: 天, 年, 时 and 间 make up most of the time words, while 多, 少, 小, 最 measure how much. Question particles 吗 and 呢 also appear.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 天 | tiān | sky; day | 今天, 明天, 昨天 |
| 年 | nián | year | 今年, 去年 |
| 时 | shí | time (日 + 寸) | 时候, 时间, 小时, 有时 |
| 间 | jiān | between; room (门 + 日) | 时间, 房间 |
| 子 | zi | child; noun suffix | 孩子, 儿子, 房子 |
| 小 | xiǎo | small | 小时 |
| 多 / 少 | duō / shǎo | many / few | 多少 |
| 最 | zuì | most | 最后 |

## Watch out

- 小 (small) vs 少 (few): 少 adds a slanting stroke at the bottom.
- 再 (again) vs 在 (at): both zài.
- 白 vs 百 (bǎi, hundred) vs 日: 白 has a short stroke on top.
- 天 vs 夫 (fū): in 夫 the vertical pokes through the top.
- 子 is toneless zi as a suffix (房子) and zǐ as "child".

cards.Example: 我可以用吗? wǒ kěyǐ yòng ma: Can I use it?
cards.Notes: Looks like a fenced frame; 5 strokes. 用 vs 甩 (shuǎi, fling): 甩's middle stroke hooks out

cards.Example: 人很多。 rén hěn duō: There are lots of people.
cards.Notes: Two 夕 stacked on top of each other: more and more

cards.Example: 我有两个姐姐。 wǒ yǒu liǎng ge jiějie: I have two older sisters.
cards.Notes: Use 两 before measure words (两个), 二 for counting and numbers

cards.Example: 等一下! děng yíxià: Wait a moment!
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo + 寺 sì; bamboo slips sorted into even ranks

cards.Example: 你好吗? nǐ hǎo ma: How are you?
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 马 mǎ for the sound. 吗 vs 妈 (mā, mom): 女 vs 口

cards.Example: 我等了三天。 wǒ děng le sān tiān: I waited three days.
cards.Notes: 一 above 大 (a person): what's above your head, the sky. 天 vs 夫 (fū)

cards.Example: 太好了! tài hǎo le: Great!
cards.Notes: 大 big + a dot = extra big: too. 太 vs 大 vs 犬 (quǎn, dog)

cards.Example: 你最好! nǐ zuì hǎo: You're the best!
cards.Notes: 曰 on top + 取 qǔ (take)

cards.Example: 再说一次。 zài shuō yí cì: Say it again.
cards.Notes: Same sound as 在 (at). Think 再见: see you again

cards.Example: 我很好,你呢? wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ne: I'm fine, and you?
cards.Notes: 口 mouth (particle) + 尼 ní for the sound

cards.Example: 我去过两次。 wǒ qùguo liǎng cì: I've been twice.
cards.Notes: 冫 + 欠 (open mouth). 次 vs 欢 (huān): 欢 has 又 on the left

cards.Example: 我的房间很小。 wǒ de fángjiān hěn xiǎo: My room is small.
cards.Notes: A small stroke flanked by two dots. 小 vs 少 (shǎo, few), which adds a stroke

cards.Example: 我知道了。 wǒ zhīdào le: Got it.
cards.Notes: 知 = 矢 arrow + 口; 道 has 辶 walk wrapping 首 head

cards.Example: 他来的时候,我在睡觉。 tā lái de shíhou, wǒ zài shuìjiào: When he came, I was asleep.
cards.Notes: 时 = 日 + 寸; 候 vs 侯 (hóu): 候 has an extra short vertical stroke

cards.Example: 我走了。 wǒ zǒu le: I'm off.
cards.Notes: 土 on top of a foot; it is the radical in 起 and 赶

cards.Example: 我在你后面。 wǒ zài nǐ hòumiàn: I'm behind you.
cards.Notes: Originally 'queen'; now also stands for 後 (behind, after)

cards.Example: 我没有时间。 wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān: I don't have time.
cards.Notes: 时 time (日 sun + 寸) + 间 between (门 door + 日 sun) = time span

cards.Example: 今天我做饭。 jīntiān wǒ zuòfàn: I'm cooking today.
cards.Notes: 今 vs 令 (lìng, order): 今 ends in a short 乛 stroke

cards.Example: 他们有三个孩子。 tāmen yǒu sān ge háizi: They have three kids.
cards.Notes: 孩 = 子 child + 亥 hài for the sound

cards.Example: 我是最后一个。 wǒ shì zuìhòu yí ge: I'm the last one.
cards.Notes: 最 most + 后 after = the very last

cards.Example: 她是女老师。 tā shì nǚ lǎoshī: She's a female teacher.
cards.Notes: Picture of a kneeling woman; radical in 妈 她 好 姐

cards.Example: 我等了一个小时。 wǒ děng le yí ge xiǎoshí: I waited an hour.
cards.Notes: 小 small + 时 time period; the old 时 was two hours, so the 'small' one is one hour

cards.Example: 明天我不在家。 míngtiān wǒ bú zài jiā: I won't be home tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 明 = 日 sun + 月 moon: bright

cards.Example: 这个多少钱? zhège duōshao qián: How much is this?
cards.Notes: 多 many + 少 few = 'many or few?': how much

cards.Example: 人很少。 rén hěn shǎo: There are few people.
cards.Notes: 小 small + a slanting stroke. Read shào in 少年 (youth)

cards.Example: 这间房很大。 zhè jiān fáng hěn dà: This room is big.
cards.Notes: 门 door + 日 sun: sunlight through a gap in the door

cards.Example: 他昨天来了。 tā zuótiān lái le: He came yesterday.
cards.Notes: 昨 = 日 + 乍 zhà; the same 乍 is in 作 zuò and 怎 zěn

cards.Example: 这个杯子是我的。 zhège bēizi shì wǒ de: This cup is mine.
cards.Notes: Picture of a baby in swaddling. 子 vs 了 (le): 子 has a crossbar

cards.Example: 这是我儿子。 zhè shì wǒ érzi: This is my son.
cards.Notes: 儿 vs 几 (jǐ, how many): 几 has a lid on top

cards.Example: 我明白了。 wǒ míngbai le: I get it.
cards.Notes: 明 bright (日 sun + 月 moon) + 白 white, clear = clear: understand

cards.Example: 我今年二十岁。 wǒ jīnnián èrshí suì: I'm twenty this year.
cards.Notes: 今 now + 年 year = this year

cards.Example: 她女儿十八了。 tā nǚ'ér shíbā le: Her daughter is eighteen now.
cards.Notes: 女 is the radical in 妈 她 姐 妹 奶

cards.Example: 我喜欢白色。 wǒ xǐhuan báisè: I like white.
cards.Notes: 日 with a short stroke on top. 白 vs 百 (bǎi, hundred), which adds 一 on top

cards.Example: 我去年去了中国。 wǒ qùnián qù le Zhōngguó: I went to China last year.
cards.Notes: 去 gone + 年 year = the year that's gone: last year

cards.Example: 不用谢。 búyòng xiè: You're welcome.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 用 use = no need

cards.Example: 他家房子很大。 tā jiā fángzi hěn dà: His family's house is big.
cards.Notes: 房 (户 door + 方 fāng for the sound) + 子 noun suffix = house

cards.Example: 我们回去吧。 wǒmen huíqu ba: Let's go back.
cards.Notes: 回 return + 去 go (away from the speaker) = go back

cards.Example: 他在房间睡觉。 tā zài fángjiān shuìjiào: He's sleeping in his room.
cards.Notes: 房 = 户 door + 方 fāng; 间 = 门 gate + 日 sun

cards.Example: 我有时不吃早饭。 wǒ yǒushí bù chī zǎofàn: Sometimes I skip breakfast.
cards.Notes: 有 have + 时 time = there are times: sometimes
